_comment: Conditions from the headers of the NPARC data files: T0 = 300 K, P0/Patm = 1.195, Pexit/P0 = 0.82 (weak shock) and 0.72 (strong shock). Geometry in inches; x/H* measured from the throat.

boundaryLayer._comment: Turbulent integral boundary layer on the top and bottom walls (boundary.js), started at the duct inlet. The inlet momentum thickness is not in the data: theta0 is a sensitivity sweep, not a fit. Side-wall layers are not modelled.
